evals.prompt: Spacing and font sizes in src/components/ are all over the place. Audit the design tokens
evals.expected_output: It checks audit categories A-H and records the current value, correct value, and priority for each inconsistency, alongside the design system document and audit log.
assertions: Every audit category A-H has a result
Each inconsistency lists the current value, correct value, and priority
The chosen ratio system (golden ratio, silver ratio, etc.) is stated
Values off the scale carry a reason

evals.prompt: Audit the design tokens across the whole repo. There are no token definitions yet
evals.expected_output: It detects that no token definitions exist and proposes starting from STEP 1 (defining tokens), without producing audit results that cite nonexistent token files.
assertions: It states that no existing token definitions were found
It lays out starting from ratio selection and token definition (STEP 1)
No finding cites a file path that does not exist
